gloss: sashimi; artfully arranged sliced raw fish

definitions.gloss: sashimi; artfully arranged sliced raw fish
definitions.explanation: A polite or refined term for sashimi, emphasizing the careful preparation and artistic presentation. Commonly used in the Kansai region and in formal dining settings.

examples.japanese: お{造|つく}りの{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I ordered an assorted sashimi platter.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}のお{造|つく}りは{鯛|たい}と{鰤|ぶり}です。
examples.english: Today's sashimi is sea bream and yellowtail.

examples.japanese: {旅館|りょかん}の{夕食|ゆうしょく}に{立派|りっぱ}なお{造|つく}りが{出|で}て{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was impressed by the magnificent sashimi served at the inn's dinner.

notes:
USAGE:
お{造|つく}り is a more refined way to say {刺身|さしみ}. It is the standard term in the Kansai region and is commonly used on menus at higher-end restaurants and traditional Japanese inns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{造|つく}りの{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ (assorted sashimi platter)
- {本日|ほんじつ}のお{造|つく}り (today's sashimi)
- お{造|つく}り{五|ご}{種|しゅ}{盛|も}り (five-variety sashimi platter)

REGIONAL NOTE:
In Kansai, お{造|つく}り is the default term, while {刺身|さしみ} is more common in Kanto. In formal dining contexts nationwide, both are used.
